engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row194 Wistron-GPU RAS-00027-V002: approve platform/UBB/BMC/host and device0 UUID/OAM/BDF/UMC plus address0x800 mapping; confirm subtype0/type4 CRC-read replay-correctable semantics and decoded UMC/ext15/EndToEndCrcErr/corrected relationship, amdgpuras/cdump_analyzer versions/hashes/licenses, authenticated Systems/UBB Dump endpoint and collision-safe attribution, replay/deferred quiet-window oracle and GPU/BMC/host no-retry recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact CRC-read replay variant and ext15 oracle while preventing confusion with neighboring HBMEccErr or CRC-write modes.
independent_technical_reasoning: Subtype0 versus subtype2 is material: both are type4 UMC replay commands at the same address but must decode to different CPER error classes. Therefore command success and a generic corrected UMC record are insufficient; ext15 EndToEndCrcErr must appear in the same attributable CPER as the mapped OAM/UMC location. Replay activity must quiesce, and any deferred or uncorrected escalation changes the safety outcome and forbids retry.
